lines.lyric_translation: I’m still young and just a child

lines.lyric: Eoneu han got didil su eomneun nan ama nan
lines.lyric_hangul: 어느 한 곳 디딜 수 없는 난 아마 난
lines.lyric_translation: Me who can’t set foot on anywhere will probably
Even as I try to endure it
I wander deeper again, standing alone

lines.lyric_hangul: 갈수록 내게 또 다른 것들이 자리해 어서 빨리
lines.lyric_translation: As time passes / More fears take place in me, quickly
Save me, oh save me

lines.lyric: Namgyeojin igose na hollo deoneun andwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 남겨진 이곳에 나 홀로 더는 안돼
lines.lyric_translation: I’m alone in this place I’m left behind, I can’t do this anymore

lines.lyric: Oh save me, oh save me
lines.lyric_hangul: Oh, save me, oh, save me
lines.lyric_translation: Oh save me, oh save me

lines.lyric: Memareun gashin neol jjireuji aneul teni
lines.lyric_hangul: 메마른 가신 널 찌르지 않을 테니
lines.lyric_translation: My dried thorns won’t prick you
If I go find you first
Please caress me again
I’ll be fine
I’ll be fine
The words full of warmth…
…you gave me back then

lines.lyric_hangul: 촉촉이 감싸던 그날의 한마디도 없는 넌 아마 넌
lines.lyric_translation: You who doesn’t say anything… / …unlike that day that you embraced me moistly

lines.lyric: I will find you nal ijeun
lines.lyric_translation: I will find you

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 잊은 채로 지나가는 너를 이젠
lines.lyric_translation: You who’s passing by as you forgot about me

lines.lyric_hangul: 움켜쥐고 선 다시 날 바라보게 해야 해 어서 빨리
lines.lyric_translation: I have to grab you and make you look at me again / quickly

lines.lyric_translation: My dried thorns won’t prick you

lines.lyric: Nalkko buseureojineun momi boini ijeneun na
lines.lyric_hangul: 낡고 부스러지는 몸이 보이니 이제는 나
lines.lyric_translation: Do you see my worn out and crumbling body? Now I
Have no choice but to stand up
Save me, oh save me
